selection_note: Stratified, high-scoring examples from common agent-harness modules. This is a calibration set, not an unbiased prevalence sample.

labels.notes: Coherent 15-commit resolve chain: tail reads, checkpoint/restore, durable projection cache, listing integration, review repairs and validation.
Clear executor-collapse invariant with scoped resolution, prompt contract and regression coverage.
Per-model capability overrides and compatibility switches are coherent; one upstream merge commit is noise but does not obscure the workflow.
Small, well-tested persistent-shell lifecycle fix with a clear behavioral invariant.
Bounded network-connectivity checks and auth fallback are useful; drop the merged-upstream commit before Workflow synthesis.
Compact-record stream readers and early-exit behavior form a coherent performance workflow, though the storage representation is repository-specific.
Excellent minimal episode: reserve output tokens in the compaction threshold and prove it with a targeted regression test.
Contains two unrelated fixes: provider base_url isolation and update stash-conflict recovery. Extract two Actions; do not emit one Workflow.
Clear parent-state corruption fix: clone plugin context before delegated execution, with a focused test.
Clamp oversized approval deadlines at the configuration boundary and fail closed if the deadline primitive is unavailable.
Coherent credential-persistence workflow across desktop, CLI and server; tests cover secret placement and model-list preservation.
MCP toolset layering is coherent; exclude the unrelated release-author-map commit.
Strong retry-policy workflow spanning compaction and branch summarization; remove the merged-upstream commit before ordering steps.
Excellent cross-provider pattern candidate: preserve provider HTTP response bodies behind a normalized error interface.
Aligns multiple provider adapters on a provider-neutral field while retaining raw stop reasons and per-provider tests.
Small provenance-preservation episode with implementation, UI consumption and a regression test.
Reusable device-code OAuth flow separation with protocol types and focused tests.
Configuration-to-prompt contract for disabling built-in tools; compact and fully tested.
Complete provider-integration episode covering discovery, metadata caching, model construction, tests and documentation.
Azure/OpenAI configuration adaptation with CLI plumbing and broad regression updates.
Narrow but well-tested credential-discovery correction for AWS_PROFILE.
Useful shell-quoting Action, but the local episode has no test evidence and is too small to support a full Workflow alone.
Minimal implementation-plus-test workflow for preserving system-prompt policy in generated commit messages.
Coherent large feature, but unified-diff editing format is less suitable than common harness infrastructure for the first causal pilot.
